sources.title: Persistent Tissue-Level Hypoperfusion (No-Reflow) Negates the Clinical Benefit of Successful Thrombectomy
sources.type: Clinical: post hoc pooled analysis of EXTEND-IA and EXTEND-IA TNK trials (n=456 analysed of 537)
sources.full_text_access: Not open access (no PMC record). Only the PubMed abstract was retrieved.
sources.measured_variables: eTICI angiographic grade; no-reflow defined as >15% reduction of relative CBF or CBV on 24-h perfusion CT/MRI; 90-day mRS (favourable 0-2); follow-up infarct volume
sources.summary_statistics_in_abstract: favourable outcome 13/30 (no-reflow), 81/120 (complete flow), 150/238 (eTICI 2b), 34/68 (unsuccessful); aOR 0.31 [0.12-0.77] vs complete flow
sources.reason: Outputs are patient-level clinical/imaging outcomes. The engines output in-vitro hydraulic quantities (inlet pressure, flow in µL/min, carryover %) and prescribed-permeability tracer fractions. No mapping exists from microfluidic switching physics to mRS or infarct volume; using these numbers as validation would be invalid.

sources.title: Modeling Ischemia-Reperfusion Injury in Stroke Using the BBB Chip
sources.type: Experimental in-vitro BBB chip (HBMEC + astrocytes + pericytes + microglia), OGD/R injury, drug screen
sources.full_text_access: Open access. Full text downloaded and searched.

attempts: https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/12508954/bin/ao5c06071_si_001.pdf -> returned an HTML page, not the PDF
not_retrieved.described_in_main_text_as: Figures S1-S5 (mRNA, GO analysis, drug effect on permeability). Not inspected.

sources.measured_variables: 4 and 40 kDa FITC-dextran permeability (vessel->brain side, plate-reader fluorescence), cell viability, apoptosis, mitochondrial function, transcriptome, ELISA (IL-1beta), immunostaining
sources.perfusion_method: Chips on a swing bed/shaker (gravity-driven rocking). No pump, no reported pressure, flow rate or shear stress.
sources.numeric_values_available_in_text: None for permeability: results are given only in figures (Figure 1f, 2d, S5); no tables or raw data files located.
sources.role: BACKGROUND ONLY (supports that OGD/R increases BBB permeability)
sources.reason: (1) In the engine, permeability is an INPUT prescribed by the user, not a prediction, so measured permeability cannot test the model. (2) No pressure/flow/switching data exist to compare with the hydraulic outputs (rocker-driven, unreported flow). (3) Values only in figures; digitising them would add extraction error and could at most PARAMETERISE the injury multiplier (calibration), never validate it.

sources.title: A BBB-on-a-Chip for Ischemic Stroke Modeling: In Situ Multiparameter Monitoring with Integrated TEER and Ion Sensors
sources.type: Experimental in-vitro BBB chip with integrated TEER and K+ electrodes, OGD/R
sources.full_text_access: Not open access (no PMC record). Only the PubMed abstract was retrieved.
sources.summary_statistics_in_abstract: baseline TEER 200.18 Ohm·cm2; TEER -46.41% during OGD; recovery to ~73% of control after reperfusion; extracellular K+ +23.8% during OGD
sources.reason: The engines do not compute TEER, electrical resistance or ion concentrations. TEER and tracer permeability are related but not interconvertible without a calibrated, model-specific relationship. Abstract-level summary values with no sample size, variance or raw data cannot support an error analysis.

statement_B: Independent empirical validation is not currently possible with the available data.
